answers.question: What were net sales by product category in 2025?
answers.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    Product[Category],
    TREATAS ( { 2025 }, 'Date'[Year] ),
    "Net Sales", [Net Sales]
)
ORDER BY [Net Sales] DESC

answers.question: How did net sales and gross margin percent move by quarter in 2025?
answers.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'Date'[Quarter],
    TREATAS ( { 2025 }, 'Date'[Year] ),
    "Net Sales", [Net Sales],
    "Gross Margin %", [Gross Margin %]
)
ORDER BY 'Date'[Quarter]

answers.question: Which stores sold the most in 2025?
answers.dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN (
    5,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
        Store[Store Name],
        TREATAS ( { 2025 }, 'Date'[Year] ),
        "Net Sales", [Net Sales]
    ),
    [Net Sales], DESC
)

answers.question: How many orders did we take each month in 2025?
answers.dax:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
    'Date'[Month Number],
    'Date'[Month],
    TREATAS ( { 2025 }, 'Date'[Year] ),
    "Orders", [Orders]
)
ORDER BY 'Date'[Month Number]
